text: Rafael Delacroix scored a fantastic goal for Westport Albion at 30 minutes, bringing the score level at 2-2 after they were trailing 1-2. The goal came from a patient team build-up of 10 passes over nearly 40 seconds, starting with a smart interception by Marek Zielinski deep in their own half. Dylan Rahman delivered a perfect cross from the wing, setting up Delacroix, who finished from close range—a chance so good it usually results in a goal almost every time (xG 0.976) [#535] [#550] [#553].
